bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make this black and white, please. Just remove the colour—don't change anything else or crop it.
bank.Black-and-white treatment: Neutral grayscale across the whole photo, not sepia or selective colour.
bank.What to preserve: Everything except colour, including the car, street, background and full original framing.
bank.Size and format: One image in the original shape of the photo (5:3); free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: Could you make this pic black and white, please? I’ve been wondering how it would look without the colour. What I mean is just remove the colour and don’t change anything else. I’m a little nervous about asking for an edit when I already like the photo as it is. Please don’t crop it either.
